title: mentha × rotundifolia subsp. alopecuroides
intro: Mentha × rotundifolia subsp. alopecuroides, commonly known as Woolly Mint, is a subspecies of the peppermint plant, known for its distinctive woolly leaves. The health benefits of Woolly Mint include its potential to aid in digestion, alleviate nausea, and exhibit antibacterial properties, making it a valuable addition to natural remedies. Its therapeutic actions include calming the digestive system, relieving stress and anxiety, and exhibiting anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Mint include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
